races.paceDynamic: Fiorella Princess will lead unopposed early with five prominent runners (Hover On The Wind, Rebel Path, Over Spiced, Merrimack, Mick's Spirit) creating a wall of pace behind her. This congestion will force tactical decisions 3f out as the prominent brigade jostle for position into the straight. The solo leader and sustained gallop will stretch the field, creating gaps for the six hold-up horses to exploit late. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace and prominent congestion will string out the field perfectly for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners clash 2f out creating gaps
scenarios.body: The pace collapse allows Patient closers like Lion's House and Sandscreendeliverd to sweep through late. The tactical speed and class of these hold-up types proves decisive when the early pace tells.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent horse detaches from the pack cleanly
scenarios.body: Hover On The Wind or Merrimack use their tactical speed to slip the congestion and hold off late closers. Their recent form and race fitness gives them the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Solo leader holds on
scenarios.trigger: If Fiorella Princess gets soft fractions uncontested
scenarios.body: The lone leader builds an unassailable advantage while the pack behind fight each other. Her recent course second and Harry Davies booking suggests she's primed for this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic chaos upset
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes multiple interference incidents
scenarios.body: A horse from the back like Komorkis or an early victim gets a dream run through the carnage. The pace collapse and clear passage allows an unexpected winner to emerge.

races.paceDynamic: Age Of Time will lead unopposed with only Three On Thursday and Rusheen Boy showing any interest in racing prominently early. This creates a controlled tempo scenario where the lone leader can dictate fractions without pressure through the first half-mile. The large field of hold-up horses will bunch behind the modest early pace, setting up a sprint finish from the 2f pole. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the lack of pace pressure allows closers to get into contention and the bunched field creates opportunities for late runners to weave through.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time sets slow fractions and the field stays bunched entering the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to close ground effectively while those racing prominently find little cover and face the longest run to the line. Multiple closers get first run and the winner emerges from deep.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Three On Thursday or Rusheen Boy apply early pressure to Age Of Time creating a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and those racing closer to the pace have positional advantage entering the straight. Hold-up horses find fewer gaps as the field strings out more.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Age Of Time Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Age Of Time to build an insurmountable lead before the closers can organize their challenge. The field's reluctance to commit early costs them dearly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Bunch Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and 12+ runners hit the straight in contention
scenarios.body: The crawling pace creates a cavalry charge finish where traffic problems and racing room become decisive factors. Any horse getting a clear run can win but many good horses get stopped.

watchPoints.text: Age Of Time breaking smartly and getting uncontested lead - if allowed easy fractions through first half-mile becomes very dangerous
Three On Thursday and Rusheen Boy applying early pressure to the leader - any pace pressure changes the complexion dramatically

Traffic problems in straight given 16-runner field and bunched finish likely - draw and racing room become crucial factors
Gladiadora carrying top weight with inexperienced rider - 5lb claim helps but jockey's handling of big field finish questionable

races.paceDynamic: Aigeas and Wield will clash for the early lead, with both horses showing clear front-running tendencies from their recent form. This dual pace angle should create an honest gallop over the 7f trip, particularly with Aigeas having won from the front at Salisbury and Wield showing consistent early pace in recent starts. The likely pace battle will set up a genuine test, stringing out this small field of six. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine early pace will allow closers to time their run and pick up the pieces from the tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Aigeas and Wield engage in a pace duel from the start
scenarios.body: The early leaders will compromise each other, creating perfect stalking conditions for the back-markers. The Publican's Son and Spirit Of Saxony can time their runs to perfection with Buick and Bishop knowing exactly when to press the button.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives duel
scenarios.trigger: If one of Aigeas or Wield can establish a clear advantage early
scenarios.body: The winner settles into a rhythm after seeing off their rival, maintaining enough energy to resist the closers in the final furlong. Aigeas looks the stronger of the two pace angles given his recent Salisbury success.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent racer strikes perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If I'll Be Back can secure the ideal tracking position behind the pace battle
scenarios.body: Burke's charge can benefit from the strong gallop without getting involved in the early skirmishing, striking at the perfect moment when the leaders tire. The 146-day break is a concern but the Salisbury win was impressive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical contest emerges
scenarios.trigger: If both Aigeas and Wield show restraint and refuse to commit early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes moderate allowing all styles to remain competitive, turning this into a sprint finish where class and tactical positioning matter most. The Publican's Son's superior RPR of 109 becomes decisive in a bunch finish.

watchPoints.text: Wield and Aigeas must both be monitored for early pace clash that could set up the race for hold-up horses perfectly.
The Publican's Son despite highest rating has been off 188 days and needs to prove fitness first time back for O'Brien.
I'll Be Back carries a fitness doubt after 146-day break but Burke's 2/13 recent record suggests confidence in bringing one back fresh.
Spirit Of Saxony has solid recent form but Johnson Houghton yard is 0/9 in last 14 days suggesting stable is out of form.
Luansobe's 154-day absence combined with Fellowes' poor recent strike rate makes this a tough comeback assignment.

scenarios.label: C
